name.en: Soft vinyl 1/144 snowman type ad balloon

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム 0080 ポケットの中の戦争』に登場したスノーマン型のアドバルーンが1/144スケールと並べて楽しめる彩色済・組立不要のソフビになって登場！
description.en: The snowman-shaped ad balloon that appeared in "Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket" is now available as a painted soft vinyl with no assembly required that can be enjoyed side by side with 1/144 Scale!

description.ja: ソフビでありながらバルーンならではの細部のシワなどディテールまで再現。
description.en: Even though it is soft vinyl, it reproduces details such as the wrinkles that are unique to balloons.
